Hi Sara — thanks for the list. High level answers below; I attached a short export playbook and schema sample for your security team to review.

- Destinations: We support push to S3 (AWS), GCS, or a customer SFTP endpoint. For S3/GCS we can either push directly into a customer-managed bucket (requires granting a short-lived write role or using presigned URLs) or deliver to Redwood-managed staging with transfer to customer on request.

- Formats: Exports are available as NDJSON (one JSON event per line) or compressed CSV. The attached log_export_schema.csv shows fields (timestamp, actor_id, event_type, resource_id, request_id, ip, user_agent, region, kv_meta). For SIEM customers we also support common syslog/CEF formatting via a translation layer.

- Lead time: For cached/rolling windows (last 90 days) we can deliver within 24–48 hours. For larger historical archives (6–24 months) we typically schedule a bulk extraction; SLA is 48–72 hours depending on volume and region. If you need an immediate snapshot we can prioritize but a rush fee may apply for very large volumes.

- Deletion / proof: Deletion in hosted tenants follows a two-step purge: 1) data is tombstoned (marked deleted, inaccessible) immediately; 2) background compaction permanently removes blobs within 30 days. For Dedicated/Private we can provide longer tear-down windows and an evidence package. For audit proof we provide a signed deletion manifest and an export of tombstone logs. We can also provide a hash-chain summary for tamper evidence if required by procurement.

Next steps: see attached export_instructions.pdf and schema sample. Can you confirm the desired destination (S3/GCS/SFTP) and whether you require encryption key handover (SSE-C/SSE-KMS) or Redwood-managed keys? Also confirm the region (us-east-1 / eu-west-1) for residency mapping.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Sara / Acme security — following up with the clarifications Marissa asked for and some firmed-up delivery expectations: 

1) Time-bounded exports: yes — exports accept start/end timestamps as parameters. For API-driven pulls use the /export/v1/audit endpoint with query params start_ts / end_ts; in the playbook we include an example curl that produces an NDJSON slice. For very large slices we stage to a presigned S3/GCS location and provide a manifest.

2) Encryption / key management: We support three modes — Redwood-managed keys (default, SSE-S3/SSE-GCS), customer KMS integration with IAM role grant (recommended for Dedicated), and SSE-C for SFTP transfers. If Acme requires key handover we need to coordinate an IAM role or provide a public PGP key for direct-encrypted exports.

3) Legal hold: We will suspend automatic purge for tenants with an active legal hold; retention timers stop while the hold is active. Legal hold is a service-level operation that requires signed authorization from your legal or security contact; once lifted, standard purge timers resume.

4) PII redaction: We can apply field-level redaction as part of the export pipeline for specific fields (example: obfuscate email:user@domain -> user@[redacted-domain]) or deliver raw logs and let customers run redaction downstream. Field-level redaction requires an acknowledgement of potential impact to forensic completeness.

5) Delivery SLA: For standard snapshots (<= 90 days) 24–48 hours. For bulk historical extracts (>= 6 months) 48–72 hours; very large datasets (>10 TB) may require a multi-day plan. We will surface estimated size ahead of extraction and provide a signed delivery window via the SUP ticket.

6) Proof of deletion: We provide a signed deletion manifest listing object keys, timestamps, and SHA256 hashes. For higher-assurance requirements we can produce a chained hash report (tamper-evident) and a short audit artifact bundle.

Next steps: Please confirm (1) desired destination (S3/GCS/SFTP) and bucket/path, (2) region (us-east-1 / eu-west-1), (3) whether Acme needs customer KMS or Redwood-managed keys, and (4) whether any legal holds exist now. Once we have that, we'll open SUP-1456 and schedule extraction.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min tech call if helpful.

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
